priorityList: Cast Vile Taint to apply Agony and Corruption to all targets in the pack.
Cast Soul Rot on cooldown to trigger Soul Harvester hero traits and apply Soul Anathema.
Cast Phantom Singularity on the primary target.
Cast Summon Darkglare to extend the duration of active damage-over-time effects.
Cast Malefic Rapture to spend Soul Shards and trigger Shared Fate procs on affected targets.
Cast Seed of Corruption if Corruption needs to be refreshed on the pack or as a shard spender when Malefic Rapture is less efficient.
Maintain Unstable Affliction on the highest priority target for Soul Shard generation via Nightfall.
Use Drain Soul as a filler and to generate Soul Shards by sniping dying targets.
